E1290

Jetos real VM proof needs real tools.

What

Jetos real VM proof needs real tools.

Why

D-JOS-REALGUEST1=C requires actual installed-guest behavior before JetOS can claim NixOS replacement readiness. Script fixtures and fake QEMU tools may test harness plumbing, but they cannot close replacement acceptance.

Fix

Rerun without `--real` for plumbing tests, or put real QEMU/image/media tools on PATH before claiming replacement proof.
